title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-olivia-martin
content:
Weekly release train prep notes - quick scratchpad
Owners: Olivia Martin (release train lead), Samir Patel (runtime), Priya Kapoor (console), Evan Ramirez (SRE)
Context: target launch window next Tuesday (2026-03-09). This is the weekly go/no-go readout; below are the items I want covered in the sync and follow-ups I need to track.

Agenda (15-20m total)
- Quick status round (2m each owner)
- Go/no-go checklist review (10m)
- Major risks/blockers + mitigation (5m)
- Action items & owners (2m)

Current overall status: AMBER -> can go if all high-priority blockers closed by EOD Friday. Still 3 high-priority items outstanding (see blockers).

GO/NO-GO checklist (high-level) - call out what must be green:
- Release artifacts built and verified: build tags present, container images pushed to registry (runtime:v2026.3.9) -> Samir
  - Verify digest matches signed artifact: docker sha present in release notes
- Integration tests: full smoke + canary traffic tests passed in staging -> Priya
  - Must have <1% error rate on 99th percentile latency for 10k sample requests
- Infra readiness: capacity reservation for Dedicated pool + autoscaling config validated -> Evan
- Security/compliance: KMS key rotation & audit logs checked, secrets stored in vault -> Security reviewed (legal ok)
- Migration/data: KV cache migration script dry-run on staging (no more than 2% misses after warm-up) -> Samir
- Rollout plan: canary schedule, automated rollback policy present and tested -> Olivia
- Monitoring & alerting: dashboards live, SLO burn alerts configured, runbook and oncall assigned -> Evan
- Customer comms: pre-launch e-mail + status page draft ready -> Priya

Criteria for GO: all items above marked green OR explicit mitigations+timeboxed workaround agreed with execs.

Open Blockers (priority order)
1) Runtime OOM under long context (high) - reproduces in staging when sending ~32k token requests with batch mix B. Cause: memory leak in kv-cache eviction logic introduced in PR #842. Samir investigating; proposed short-term mitigation: limit max_context to 16k for canary and throttle large requests at the API gateway. Long-term fix on PR pipeline. Target: regression fix merged + staging re-run by Thu EOD.
   - Implications: If unresolved, must restrict public release to models/configs that do not allow >16k context.
   - Tickets: JIRA RDT-1287, linked PR github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/862

2) Canary metrics not reporting in the dashboard (medium-high) - missing trace enrichment causing alerts to not surface; affects SRE confidence for automated rollback triggers. Evan to validate logging pipeline; temporary workaround: add ad-hoc Prometheus scraping job + Slack bridge alert rule. Target: fix in place by Fri morning.
   - Ticket: INFRA-311

3) Console rollout UI inconsistent for feature flags (medium) - some customers see new UI before flags applied; regression from race condition in feature flag eval. Priya on a hotfix. If not done, we'll disable feature flag rollout for first wave. Target: Fri noon.
   - Ticket: CONSOLE-47

Outstanding validation checks
- End-to-end latency regression test for embeddings (run full dataset vs baseline) -> results due Thu 18:00 by Priya
- Load test for dedicated pool under expected burst pattern -> Evan to run Wed-Fri windows, collect 95/99/99.9p latency
- Security: conduct one last quick penetration smoke test on staging -> Security done by Thu

Canary plan (proposed)
- Canary size: 1% initial traffic for 30m, increase to 5% for 1h, 20% for 2h, then full if no regressions.
- Traffic split by model and customer tier (priority to prod-level customers flagged in rollout sheet).
- Automated rollback on: error rate >2% sustained for 5m OR 99.9p latency > 2x baseline for 5m.
- Manual gates: require SRE ack at 5% and 20% increases.

Rollback playbook (short)
- If automated rollback triggers: system will switch traffic to fallbacks (model-variant B or older deployment) and notify #prod-ops + oncall.
- If manual rollback needed: release lead initiates rollback in console -> Samir executes re-deploy -> Evan validates infra scaling and metrics.
- Post-rollback: hot-patch branch created, postmortem template pre-filled.

Communication plan
- Pre-launch email to pilot customers (Priya) by Mon EOD with feature summary + known limitations
- Incident/launch channel: #launch-2026-03-09 (create if not exists) -> Olivia to own
- Status page: ops team to prepare automatic updates if incidents occur -> Evan

Action items (owner - due)
- Samir: merge OOM regression fix + run full staging sanity -> Thu EOD (2026-03-05)
- Evan: fix dashboard metric pipeline + run dedicated pool load tests -> Fri AM (2026-03-06)
- Priya: complete embeddings latency regression report + finalize customer comms draft -> Thu 18:00 (2026-03-05)
- Olivia: finalize canary schedule and ensure oncall rotations in roster -> Fri EOD (2026-03-06)
- Security (Ana Torres): final smoke pentest sign-off -> Thu (2026-03-05)
- All: confirm linked artifacts updated (CONFLUENCE-RT/launch-checklist) -> Fri noon (2026-03-06)

Notes to self / follow-ups after meeting
- If Samir's fix misses Thu, prepare contingency to limit max_context and document customer-facing limitation (short note for comms).
- Remind Priya to run the embeddings regression against the exact prometheus sampling window used in baseline. Avoid mismatch.
- Check PR #842, #862 for any related changes; call out authors for quick pairing if necessary.

Quick links (placeholders to update during sync)
- Launch checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/RT/launch-checklist
- Release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/RT/release-notes-2026-03-09
- Staging dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rt/staging-release
- JIRA epic: RDT-1234
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pulls

Prep questions for owners (for the sync)
- Samir: can you confirm repro steps + confidence level on fix by Tue? Are there any additional regressions we should expect?
- Evan: will the fallback capacity be able to absorb canary rollback traffic at scale?
- Priya: are there any customers in the pilot list who require advance notice >48h?

End - bring any late blockers into the channel early. I'll update this doc after the meeting and convert into the formal release pad in Confluence once items are green.

Quick status summary (for exec Slack update) - to be filled post-meeting:
- Overall: AMBER -> potential GO if top-3 issues resolved by Fri EOD
- Major blocker: runtime OOM (high)
- Canary plan: defined, automated rollback in place
- Next update: Fri 12:00 PT (Olivia)
